recipes.dish_name: Seared Tuna & White Bean Power Bowl

nutrition.highlights: ULTRA HIGH **protein** from tuna (40g) + beans (16g). Extremely rich in **Omega-3 fatty acids**. High in iron, selenium, and B vitamins. Performance athlete-level nutrition.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Fresh tuna steaks 350g (sushi-grade if eating rare)
2. Cannellini beans 2 tins (800g), drained
3. Cherry tomatoes 250g, halved
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 minced, 2 sliced)
5. Baby spinach 3 cups
6. Lemon zest and juice 1 lemon
7. Fresh basil 1/2 cup torn
8. Parmesan 30g grated
9. Olive oil 4 tbsp
10. Balsamic vinegar 1 tbsp
11. Dijon mustard 1 tsp
12. Salt and pepper
13. Sesame seeds for crusting tuna
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

1. **Ninja SmartLid:** Select SEAR/SAUTÉ mode. Add 2 tbsp olive oil.
2. Add sliced garlic, cook 1 min until golden.
3. Add cherry tomatoes, cook 3 min until starting to burst.
4. Add cannellini beans, lemon zest, salt, pepper.
5. Lock lid, select PRESSURE COOK, 5 min.
6. Quick release. Select SEAR/SAUTÉ, add spinach, stir until wilted (2 min).
7. Stir in half the basil, lemon juice, Parmesan. Keep warm.
8. **While beans cook:** Pat tuna steaks very dry. Season with salt, pepper.
9. Press sesame seeds onto both sides of tuna.
10. Brush with 1 tbsp olive oil.
11. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Preheat 3 min at 200°C. Add tuna steaks.
12. Air fry at 200°C for 6-8 min (6 min for rare, 8 min for medium-rare, 12 min for well done).
13. **Make dressing:** Whisk remaining olive oil, balsamic vinegar, minced garlic, Dijon mustard.
14. **To serve:** Divide warm bean mixture among bowls.
15. Slice tuna steaks thickly. Arrange over beans.
16. Drizzle with dressing, top with remaining basil.

**Protein tip:** Fresh tuna has MORE protein than chicken breast! Searing keeps it moist. The sesame crust adds texture and healthy fats.

**Time:** 30 minutes total
**Protein:** 56g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of seared sesame-crusted tuna slices (pink in the middle) over a bed of white beans with tomatoes and wilted spinach, garnished with basil.

recipes.ingredients:

3. Broccoli 300g, cut into florets
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 minced, 2 whole)
5. Vegetable broth 2.5 cups
6. Lemon juice and zest 1 lemon
7. Fresh dill 1/3 cup
8. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup
9. Dijon mustard 2 tsp
10. Tahini 2 tbsp
11. Cumin 1 tsp
12. Olive oil

recipes.instructions:

3. When done, quick release. Drain excess liquid if any. Remove garlic cloves, mash and return to lentils.
4. Stir in lemon zest, half the dill, 1 tbsp olive oil. Keep warm.
5. **While lentils cook:** Season salmon with salt, pepper, lemon juice. Brush with olive oil.

11. Drizzle generously with yogurt-tahini sauce.

**Protein:** 54g per serving

recipes.dish_name: Double Protein Salmon with Herbed Cottage Cheese

nutrition.highlights: ULTRA HIGH **protein** from salmon (35g) + cottage cheese (17g). Rich in **Omega-3 fatty acids**, calcium, and complete amino acids. Low carb, muscle-building powerhouse.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Salmon fillets 400g (2 large fillets)
2. Cottage cheese 200g (high protein variety)
3. Baby potatoes 300g, halved
4. Asparagus or green beans 200g
5. Fresh dill 1/4 cup chopped
6. Fresh chives 2 tbsp chopped
7. Garlic 2 cloves minced
8. Lemon zest and juice 1 lemon
9. Capers 1 tbsp
10. Olive oil
11. Dijon mustard 1 tsp
12. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:

3. **While potatoes cook:** Season salmon with salt, pepper, lemon zest. Brush with olive oil.
4. Trim asparagus/beans, toss with 1 tsp olive oil.
5. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** After potatoes cook 10 min, add salmon skin-side down. Air fry at 180°C for 10 min.
6. **After salmon cooks 5 min:** Add asparagus/beans around salmon. Continue cooking. Use SYNC FINISH so all finish together.
7. **Make herbed cottage cheese:** Mix cottage cheese, dill, chives, minced garlic, lemon juice, capers, Dijon mustard, salt, pepper.

9. Top salmon generously with herbed cottage cheese (serves as creamy sauce).

**Protein:** 52g per serving

recipes.instructions:

**Protein:** 50g per serving

recipes.dish_name: Greek Baked Ricotta with Eggs & Lentils

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from ricotta (20g) + eggs (18g) + lentils (8g). Exceptional calcium source. Complete amino acids. Vegetarian protein powerhouse.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Ricotta cheese 300g (full fat for richness)
2. Eggs 6
3. Cooked lentils 1 cup (or 1 tin, drained)
4. Spinach 2 cups chopped
5. Sundried tomatoes 1/3 cup chopped
6. Feta cheese 80g crumbled
7. Garlic 3 cloves minced
8. Fresh oregano 2 tbsp (or 1 tsp dried)
9. Lemon zest 1 lemon
10. Pine nuts 2 tbsp
11. Olive oil
12. Wholegrain bread or pita
13. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid (if cooking lentils from scratch) + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**If using dried lentils:**
1. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup dried lentils, 2.5 cups water, pinch salt.
2. Lock lid, PRESSURE COOK 10 min. Quick release. Drain and set aside.

**If using canned lentils, start here:**
3. In large bowl, mix ricotta, 2 eggs (lightly beaten), minced garlic, oregano, lemon zest, salt, pepper until smooth.
4. Fold in cooked/canned lentils, chopped spinach, sundried tomatoes, half the feta.
5. Pour mixture into oven-safe dish that fits in air fryer (or 2 smaller dishes for both zones).
6. Make 4 wells in the mixture. Crack remaining 4 eggs into wells.
7. Top with remaining feta and pine nuts. Drizzle with olive oil.
8. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Place dish in basket. Air fry at 170°C for 15-18 min until eggs set (yolks still slightly runny) and top golden.
9. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Add thick slices of bread. Toast at 180°C for 4 min. Time so bread finishes when eggs do.
10. Let rest 3 min before serving.
11. Serve directly from dish with toasted bread.

**Protein tip:** Ricotta has nearly as much protein as Greek yogurt but creamier. Baking it creates a texture like crustless quiche.

**Time:** 35 minutes total (25 min if using canned lentils)
**Protein:** 46g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of a baked ricotta casserole with visible eggs nestled in creamy white ricotta mixture, dotted with sundried tomatoes and feta, topped with toasted pine nuts.

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from tofu (32g) + quinoa (8g) + Greek yogurt (4g). Complete amino acids. High in calcium and iron. Vegan-adaptable powerhouse breakfast/lunch.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Extra-firm tofu 450g block, pressed
2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g, halved
4. Mushrooms 200g, sliced
5. Baby spinach 3 cups
6. Nutritional yeast 3 tbsp (gives cheesy flavor + B12)
7. Turmeric 1/2 tsp (for golden color)
8. Garlic powder 1 tsp
9. Smoked paprika 1/2 tsp
10. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup (or vegan alternative)
11. Fresh chives 2 tbsp
12. Olive oil
13. Salt and pepper
14. Avocado 1, sliced (optional)
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**TOFU 101 - How to make it taste amazing:**
1. **Key:** Press tofu for 10 min between paper towels with heavy object on top. Removes water = better texture.
2. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup quinoa and 1.5 cups water. Lock lid, select RICE mode (12 min).
3. **While quinoa cooks:** Crumble pressed tofu with hands into bite-size pieces (like scrambled eggs).
4. In bowl, mix crumbled tofu with nutritional yeast, turmeric, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, pepper.
5. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil until well coated (this is your 'marinade').
6. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Spread seasoned tofu in basket. Air fry at 190°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min until golden and slightly crispy.
7. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Toss mushrooms and cherry tomatoes with 1 tsp olive oil, salt, pepper. Air fry at 180°C for 12 min. Use SYNC FINISH.
8. **Last 2 min of cooking:** Add spinach to mushroom/tomato basket, let wilt.
9. **Assemble bowls:** Quinoa base, top with golden tofu scramble, roasted vegetables.
10. Dollop Greek yogurt, sprinkle chives, add avocado if using.

**Tofu tip:** Nutritional yeast + turmeric makes tofu taste eggy and cheesy! Pressing is crucial - wet tofu = mushy tofu. Air frying makes it crispy on edges.

**Time:** 32 minutes total
**Protein:** 44g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of a bowl with fluffy quinoa topped with golden, crumbly tofu scramble, roasted mushrooms and tomatoes, wilted spinach, and a dollop of yogurt.

nutrition.highlights: VERY HIGH **protein** from tempeh (31g) + quinoa (8g) + tahini (3g). Complete amino acids. Rich in probiotics, fiber, and iron. Fermented soy is easier to digest.

recipes.ingredients:
1. Tempeh 300g block
2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Edamame 1 cup (frozen, shelled)
4. Red cabbage 2 cups shredded
5. Carrot 1 large, julienned
6. Cucumber 1, sliced
7. Soy sauce or tamari 3 tbsp
8. Maple syrup 1 tbsp
9. Rice vinegar 2 tbsp
10. Sesame oil 1 tbsp
11. Tahini 3 tbsp
12. Garlic 2 cloves minced
13. Fresh coriander 1/4 cup

15. Olive oil
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja SmartLid + Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

**TEMPEH 101 - How to prepare:**
1. Cut tempeh into 1.5cm cubes or thick slices.
2. **KEY STEP:** Steam first to remove bitterness and help marinade absorb.
3. **Ninja SmartLid:** Add 1 cup water and steamer basket. Add tempeh cubes.
4. Lock lid, select STEAM mode, 5 min. Remove tempeh, pat dry.
5. **Make marinade:** Mix soy sauce, maple syrup, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, sesame oil, minced garlic.
6. Toss steamed tempeh in marinade. Let sit 5 min (longer is better).
7. **Rinse SmartLid pot.** Add 1 cup quinoa and 1.5 cups water. Lock lid, select RICE mode (12 min).
8. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Add marinated tempeh (reserve marinade). Air fry at 200°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min until golden and crispy.

10. **Make tahini dressing:** Mix tahini, remaining rice vinegar, 3 tbsp water, salt until smooth.
11. **Assemble bowls:** Quinoa base, top with crispy tempeh, edamame, cabbage, carrot, cucumber.
12. Drizzle with tahini dressing and reserved marinade.
13. Garnish with coriander and sesame seeds.

**Tempeh tip:** Steaming removes bitterness - this is the secret! Air frying makes it crispy like bacon. Tempeh has more protein than tofu.

**Time:** 34 minutes total
**Protein:** 42g per serving

**Protein:** 40g per serving

recipes.ingredients:
1. Sardines in olive oil 2 tins (220g total, drained)
2. Chickpeas 2 tins (800g), drained and dried
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g, halved
4. Garlic 4 cloves (2 whole, 2 minced)
5. Fresh parsley 1/2 cup chopped
6. Lemon juice and zest 1 lemon
7. Capers 2 tbsp
8. Kalamata olives 1/2 cup, chopped
9. Greek yogurt 1/2 cup
10. Smoked paprika 1 tsp
11. Cumin 1/2 tsp
12. Olive oil
13. Wholegrain sourdough bread 4 thick slices
14. Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
**Using Ninja Dual Zone Air Fryer:**

1. Pat chickpeas very dry. Toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, pepper.
2. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Spread chickpeas in basket. Air fry at 200°C for 18 min, shaking every 6 min until crispy.
3. **Air Fryer Zone 2:** Toss cherry tomatoes and 2 whole garlic cloves with 1 tsp olive oil. Air fry at 180°C for 12 min.
4. After tomatoes cook 8 min, add bread slices to Zone 2. Toast alongside tomatoes for final 4 min. Use SYNC FINISH.
5. **While cooking:** In bowl, mash sardines roughly with fork (keep some chunks).
6. Add minced garlic, capers, olives, lemon zest, half the parsley, 1 tbsp olive oil. Mix gently.
7. When tomatoes done, squeeze roasted garlic from skins into sardine mixture. Add half the roasted tomatoes. Fold gently.
8. **Make yogurt sauce:** Mix Greek yogurt, lemon juice, salt, pepper.
9. **To serve:** Spread yogurt sauce on toasted bread.
10. Top with sardine-chickpea mixture.
11. Add crispy chickpeas, remaining roasted tomatoes, remaining parsley.
12. Drizzle with olive oil.

**Protein tip:** Sardines are incredibly nutrient-dense - more Omega-3s than salmon! Eat the bones for calcium. The 'smash' style makes them less fishy.

**Time:** 28 minutes total
**Protein:** 38g per serving
recipes.image_description: Image of rustic open-faced sandwiches with mashed sardines and chickpeas on toasted sourdough, topped with crispy chickpeas and roasted tomatoes.

recipes.dish_name: Baked Potato with Salad and Barramundi

nutrition.highlights: High in **protein** (from barramundi). Good source of carbohydrates (potatoes) for energy, and vitamins and fiber from the fresh salad vegetables. Barramundi is also a good source of **Omega-3 fatty acids**.

recipes.ingredients:

2. Cucumber 1, diced
3. Tomatoes 2, diced
4. Capsicum 1, diced

2. Chickpeas 1 tin, drained and patted dry
3. Mixed salad leaves 4 cups

5. Cucumber 1, diced

3. **Air Fryer Zone 1:** Add chickpeas. Air fry at 200°C for 15 min, shaking every 5 min.

recipes.dish_name: Crispy Air Fryer Tofu Tahini Bowl

2. Quinoa 1 cup
3. Cherry tomatoes 200g halved
4. Cucumber 1, diced
5. Tahini 3 tbsp
6. Lemon juice 2 tbsp
7. Garlic 2 cloves minced
8. Fresh parsley 1/2 cup chopped
9. Olive oil

8. **Assemble bowls:** Divide quinoa between 2-3 bowls. Top with crispy tofu, roasted tomatoes, cucumber, parsley.

nutrition.highlights: Good source of Carbohydrates for energy. Provides **protein** (from tuna and cream cheese) and healthy fats (from avocado). Contains iodine from nori.

recipes.ingredients:

2. Rice 370g (about 1.5 cups uncooked)
3. Tuna 1 can, drained
4. Soft cheese (cream cheese) 360g
5. Cucumber 1, julienned
6. Nori sheets 4
recipes.instructions:

1. Add 1.5 cups rice and 1.8 cups water to pot.
2. Lock lid, select RICE mode (white rice setting).
3. When done, let natural release 10 min. Spread rice on tray to cool to room temperature.
4. **While rice cools:** Mix tuna with some cream cheese (about 50g) in bowl.
5. Slice avocado thinly.
6. Julienne cucumber into matchstick strips.
7. Lay out plastic wrap on flat surface.
8. Place 1 nori sheet on plastic wrap.
9. Spread thin layer of cream cheese on nori.
10. Spread layer of rice on top (about 1cm thick).
11. Place another piece of plastic wrap on top.
12. Flip entire thing so nori is on top, rice on bottom.
13. Remove top plastic wrap.
14. On the nori side, arrange line of tuna mixture, avocado, cucumber.
15. Using plastic wrap, roll tightly like sushi.
16. Wrap in plastic, refrigerate 30 min to set.
17. Slice with sharp knife into 2cm pieces.
18. Repeat with remaining ingredients.

**Time saved:** 8 minutes; perfect sushi rice every time
recipes.image_description: Image of a sliced sushi sandwich (pressed sushi) with visible layers of rice, nori, tuna mixture, avocado, and cucumber.

nutrition.highlights: Provides a good balance of carbohydrates (rice) and fiber (eggplant). Contains **protein** (cheese) and various vitamins from vegetables. A hearty and satisfying baked dish.

2. Mozzarella 200g, torn or shredded
3. Rice 1 cup uncooked
4. Capsicum 1, diced
5. Cheese (cheddar or mixed) 100g grated
6. Tomatoes 2 large, diced
7. Garlic 3 cloves minced
8. Olive oil
9. Italian herbs
10. Salt and pepper

11. Fill eggplant halves with rice mixture.
